question: Does consolidating the three adjacent Check contract paragraphs preserve detection and process behavior while reducing overhead?

method.effort: No override; session records report null, actual effort unknown.
method.assessor: /root/blind_assessment, independent fresh context, same requested model; treatment identities and instruction bodies withheld
method.adjudication: All 16 independently assessed; lead mapped neutral sample IDs back to runs after verdicts. Related weakened-test findings deduplicated with the contract failure.
method.initial_assessment_correction: Initial packets used command events alone and omitted executed checks. Full paired raw custom tool records corrected process judgments for samples 01-06 before aggregation.
method.sanitization: Candidate paths replaced with /project; source-read outputs reduced to hashes; runtime excerpts omit Darwin Python cache warnings. Credentials and account/session metadata omitted.
method.run_identity: This pilot started before run_id persistence was added. IDs derive from the runner output directory and ordered manifest plan.
limits: Four small related fixtures, two repetitions each; correctness saturated.
No claim of general reviewer quality, installed-host parity, or full panel behavior.
Assessor was treatment-blinded; lead was not. Model identity inherited knowledge cannot establish provider diversity.
Command-action events undercount executed shell commands; top-level tool calls are a separate overhead proxy.
Null effort metadata and noisy timing preclude a precise effort or causal speed claim.
